At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other Force drain bonus), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “no other Force drain bonus” to “no other bonus to your Force drain”: “Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site.
